title: Provision complete release CI runtime
summary: Provision complete bundled Python, Node, core media tools, PgsToSrt/tessdata, and runner-initialized isolated temp/AppData state for Deep Audit and Generated Drift jobs.
reason: The active Generated Drift jobs copied Python without installing bundled-runtime dependencies and did not provision media tools; the broad Python jobs also invoked bundled runtimes and Node tooling that their job setup did not provide.
behavior_before: CI release/package jobs failed on missing pydantic, psutil, pysubs2, FFmpeg, MKVToolNix, PgsToSrt/tessdata, and AppData prerequisites, while broad Python jobs could fail when browser/tooling tests spawned the unprovisioned bundled runtime.
behavior_after: All relevant CI jobs provision and validate the required bundled runtime layout without skipping release checks; isolated paths are exported from RUNNER_TEMP through GITHUB_ENV after the runner starts; PgsToSrt 1.4.8 and English tessdata are downloaded from pinned upstream revisions with SHA-256 verification; package exclusion policy is unchanged.
manual_validation: Initialize-CiMediaTools.ps1 -InstallMissing passed against an empty temporary repository root
CI-style bundled-Python discovery passed 3,131 tests with 1 expected skip after regenerating the duplicate-test report
Full source release self-test passed every required Python, generated-context, dependency, lint, WebView, PowerShell, tool-integration, and end-to-end gate
Tauri CheckOnly, cargo check --locked, cargo test --locked (43 passed), and cargo build --release --locked passed
Deployable lean package build and copied-folder plus extracted-ZIP acceptance passed with immutable package roots and zero leftover child processes
rollback_plan: Revert the workflow and CI media-provisioner changes; no packaged runtime, local operator config, or media state requires migration.
notes: Release gates remain strict. Live config, runtime state, credentials, source-control data, and optional FFplay/MKVToolNix GUI bulk exclusions were not changed. Job-level runner.temp expressions were replaced with runner-time GITHUB_ENV exports because the runner context is not available while GitHub constructs a job. Pinned downloads retry bounded transient transport failures, but every attempt must still pass the exact SHA-256 gate.
